g.text: UML Diagram: Class ClassificationIndexEntry in Context

a.title: • CatalogDetails: A set of information useful for attribution, data discovery, and access.
a.xlink:title: • CatalogDetails: A set of information useful for attribution, data discovery, and access.

a.title: • CommandCode: Contains information on the command used for processing data. Contains a description of the command which should clarify for the user the purpose and process of the command, an in-line provision of the command itself, and a reference to an external version of the command such as a coding script.
a.xlink:title: • CommandCode: Contains information on the command used for processing data. Contains a description of the command which should clarify for the user the purpose and process of the command, an in-line provision of the command itself, and a reference to an external version of the command such as a coding script.

a.title: • InternationalString: Packaging structure for multilingual versions of the same string content, represented by a set of LanguageString. a.title: • Identifier: Identifier for objects requiring short- or long-lasting referencing and management.
a.xlink:title: • Identifier: Identifier for objects requiring short- or long-lasting referencing and management.

a.title: • DateRange: Expresses a date/time range using a start date and end date (both with the structure of Date and supporting the use of ISO and non-ISO date structures). Use in all locations where a range of dates is required, i.e. validFor, embargoPeriod, collectionPeriod, etc.
a.xlink:title: • DateRange: Expresses a date/time range using a start date and end date (both with the structure of Date and supporting the use of ISO and non-ISO date structures). Use in all locations where a range of dates is required, i.e. validFor, embargoPeriod, collectionPeriod, etc.

a.title: • ClassificationIndex: Ordered list of classification index entries.
a.xlink:title: • ClassificationIndex: Ordered list of classification index entries.

a.title: • ClassificationIndexEntryPosition: Member indicator for use with member type classification index entry.
a.xlink:title: • ClassificationIndexEntryPosition: Member indicator for use with member type classification index entry.

a.title: • IndividualMember: Distinct element that is not itself a collection (atomic).
a.xlink:title: • IndividualMember: Distinct element that is not itself a collection (atomic).

a.title: • Member: Element in a collection that can be either atomic (individual member) or composite (collection).
a.xlink:title: • Member: Element in a collection that can be either atomic (individual member) or composite (collection).

a.title: • indexes: Restricts member target class to classification index entry.
a.xlink:title: • indexes: Restricts member target class to classification index entry.
